Greetings, fellow Craftinels!

This is the first ever Sentinels Craft Swap. The idea of this swap is to make something Sentinels themed for another forumite and then to swap them. Once a partner receives the item, he or she posts a picture of it here on this thread so we can all admire it!

Rules (well, technically, it's more like guidelines...):

  1. Signups are from the 25th of May - 1st of June, and partnering will be done on the 2nd of June or thereabouts. You should have sent off your crafted item to your partner by July 1st.
  2. The item that you craft must be Sentinels themed in some way.
  3. You may not send anything that is not legally shippable or that is illegal in the country of origin or destination. Also, please check postage to other countries before agreeing to send to a partner abroad. You don't want to be surprised by crazy shipping fees.
  4. The time you should put into creating your item should be somewhere between two days and a week. If you item takes considerably less time to create, you may also make a set of items to comply with this rule.
  5. Note to Playtesters: Obviously, we are not crafting and swapping anything that uses playtesting material. That'd be wrong.

If you are up for this swap, fill out this questionnaire and post it below or message it to me, if you prefer. Feel free to adjust the spelling to American English for your post. ;)

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
• Favorite Hero:  Tempest, followed by Tachyon, followed by Legacy, followed by Nightmist (who doesn't like options, right?)
  • Favorite Villain:  Gloomweaver, The Ennead, Kismet
  • Favorite Environment:  Time Cataclysm, Tomb of Anubis
  • Favorite Card:  Ghostly Images.  The mechanics are a really impressive metaphor for heroes being either inspired to do a quick action or being frozen in fear from seeing spectral images of the heroes of yesteryear.  The art and the quote do nothing but perfectly compliment exactly what they were going for with this card.
  • What kinds of crafts can you do:  Perler bead creations.  I have patterns for every revealed Nemesis symbol (except for Sky-Scraper), and have dabbled in modifying pixel art for Legacy and Mister Fixer.  I could probably figure out a way to modify other sprites for other Sentinels, but that is much more difficult than Nemesis symbols.  I'd either be willing to craft multiple Nemesis symbols or a unique sprite supplemented by Nemesis symbols.  I'll have a better idea of what to give when I know who I have and what they would like!
  • What sort of item would you like to receive:  Whatever speaks to the artist.
  • Is there anything that you do NOT want to receive (Allergies etc.):  Plants, food, animals, etc.  I doubt anyone would send an Insula Primalis plant or an amphibious chupicabra through the mail, but you can never be too careful!  Also, something that isn't made with love.
  • Would you be prepared to post to a different country/continent:  Yes.
  • Your Country of Residence:  United States
  • Anything else:  I'm relatively new in this Perler bead craft, but I'll do my best to create something unique and fun that will be appreciated.  The sooner I have someone to craft for the sooner I can figure out my design and order the beads necessary for it.  I've mainly worked on simple shapes or 8-16 bit sprites modified to Sentinels-themed creations, so I doubt I'd be able to craft a full on scene of a hero in an environment.  I posted multiple options for Hero/Villain/Environment because I'd rather someone create something they're excited about that overlaps with my interests rather than forcing someone to create something related to a character or place that doesn't excite them.  Any (or all, should you be so motivated) would be appreciated.

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Okay, I'll bite too! I have to warn you guys though, I have fibromyalgia and my flare-ups are unpredictable, so theres a small possibility that I might not make the deadline. It's unlikely, but it might happen, and I promise I'll get it out as soon as I can if I'm delayed. Assuming that's okay...?

  • Favourite Hero: I like them all, but Tachyon and Unity are probably my favourites.
  • Favourite Villain: Tricky. Possibly The Matriarch, Akash and Omnitron.
  • Favourite Environment: Insula Primalis, because dinosaurs.
  • Favourite Card: I'll get back to you on that. So many good ones.
  • What kinds of crafts can you do: Well apart from the obvious crocheted dolls, I make jewellery and other resin/polymer clay pieces (I made myself a resin pendant of Unity's nemesis symbol), I craft print and play boardgames, I can embroider and cross-stitch and my papercrafting isn't too bad.
  • What sort of item would you like to receive: If you're happy with it, I'm happy with it. I know you guys will all make cool things!
  • Is there anything that you do NOT want to receive (Allergies etc.): No caffeine or lanolin (so no wool) please! I'm not allergic, but I don't get on well with those things. Anything perishable's probably also a bad idea since I'm in the UK and it'll likely take a while to get here.
  • Would you be prepared to post to a different country/continent: Why not?
  • Your Country of Residence: UK.
